annotations.title: Scan a lease for red flags

description: Scan a US residential lease for risky, unusual or likely unenforceable clauses under that state's tenant law. Pass the full lease text. Returns every flagged clause with its severity, the risk and the state rule/citation, plus a link to the full report on redflaglease.com (quoted clauses, how to fix each one, missing protections, questions to ask, ready-to-send negotiation email, printable and emailed). Takes up to ~45 seconds. Information, not legal advice.

lease_text.description: Full text of the lease (at least a few paragraphs)

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. CA, NY, TX

name: check_lease
title: Scan a lease for red flags
